c-cpp-pro.clangdPath.description: Path to the clangd executable. If empty, C/C++ Pro searches PATH and the auto-installed binary.

c-cpp-pro.clangdArgs.description: Additional command-line arguments to pass to clangd.

c-cpp-pro.debuggerPath.description: Path to lldb-dap or gdb. If empty, C/C++ Pro will detect it automatically.

c-cpp-pro.cppStandard.description: Default C++ language standard for flag synthesis.

c-cpp-pro.cStandard.description: Default C language standard for flag synthesis.

c-cpp-pro.inactiveRegionsDimming.description: Dim inactive #ifdef preprocessor branches using native Clang AST.

c-cpp-pro.inactiveRegionForegroundColor.description: Font color applied to inactive preprocessor regions. Accepts a ThemeColor id (e.g. 'disabledForeground', 'descriptionForeground'), a hexadecimal color (e.g. '#808080'), or 'none' to preserve original syntax colors.

c-cpp-pro.inactiveRegionOpacity.description: Opacity level applied to inactive preprocessor code regions (0.1 to 1.0).

c-cpp-pro.inactiveRegionBackgroundColor.description: Optional background color applied to inactive preprocessor regions (hex color or ThemeColor id).

c-cpp-pro.postfixCompletions.description: Enable C++ Postfix Completion templates (.if, .for, .var, .unique, etc.).

c-cpp-pro.doxygen.generateOnType.description: Automatically provide Doxygen completion snippet when typing /** above a C++ declaration.

c-cpp-pro.doxygen.generateOnCodeAction.description: Provide a lightbulb Code Action to generate Doxygen documentation comments for C++ declarations.

c-cpp-pro.doxygen.generatedStyle.description: Comment style syntax used when generating Doxygen comment blocks.

c-cpp-pro.codeAnalysis.clangTidy.path.description: Explicit filesystem path to clang-tidy binary. If empty, C/C++ Pro searches PATH and standard LLVM directories.

c-cpp-pro.codeAnalysis.clangTidy.checks..description: List of Clang-Tidy checks or families to enable (e.g. ['modernize-*', 'readability-*']).
List of Clang-Tidy checks or families to suppress (e.g. ['modernize-use-trailing-return-type']).

c-cpp-pro.persistVsDeveloperEnvironment.description: Preserve the selected Visual Studio Developer Environment across editor restarts on Windows.

c-cpp-pro.vcpkg.enabled.description: Enable intelligent header recommendations and Code Actions for vcpkg packages.

c-cpp-pro.addNodeAddonIncludePaths.description: Auto-detect and inject include paths for nan and node-addon-api if detected in package.json.

c-cpp-pro.discovery.detectExternalSdks.description: Auto-detect common external SDKs (Vulkan SDK, raylib, CUDA Toolkit, Boost, SDL) for fallback IntelliSense flags and flag synthesis.

c-cpp-pro.default.forcedInclude.description: List of header files to force-include before compilation (/FI on MSVC, -include on GCC/Clang).

c-cpp-pro.inlayHints.parameterNames.description: Display parameter name inlay hints in function and method calls.

c-cpp-pro.inlayHints.deducedTypes.description: Display deduced type inlay hints for auto variables.

c-cpp-pro.inlayHints.designators.description: Display struct field designators in brace initialization.

c-cpp-pro.referencesCodeLens.enabled.description: Display reference counts above functions, methods, and constructors as CodeLens annotations.

c-cpp-pro.telemetry.enabled.description: Enable anonymous C++ Standard Library (STL) symbol frequency collection to boost autocomplete suggestion accuracy. Zero user code or PII is ever collected.

c-cpp-pro.telemetry.endpoint.description: Ingestion endpoint URL for anonymous STL usage telemetry batches. Must use the secure HTTPS protocol.

c-cpp-pro.cmake.autoScan.description: Automatically parse CMakeLists.txt and include discovered directories into IntelliSense.

program.description: Path to the executable binary to debug.

args.description: Command line arguments passed to the program.

cwd.description: Current working directory for the target process.

stopAtEntry.description: Automatically stop at program entry point (main).

environment.description: Environment variables to pass to the target program.

debuggerPath.description: Explicit path to lldb-dap or gdb executable.

task.description: C/C++ Pro task action name (e.g. buildActiveFile, buildWorkspace)

solution.description: Path to the .sln or .slnx solution file

languageModelTools.name: c-cpp-pro
languageModelTools.modelDescription: For the active C or C++ file, this tool provides: the language (C, C++, or CUDA), the language standard version, the compiler (GCC, Clang, or MSVC), the target platform, active preprocessor defines, and solution/build configuration.

scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['dist', 'out'].forEach(d => fs.rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true })); fs.readdirSync('.').filter(f => f.endsWith('.vsix') || f.endsWith('.obj') || f.endsWith('.pdb') || f.endsWith('.ilk')).forEach(f => fs.rmSync(f, { force: true }));"
